newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sidaoui ratified as deputy Banco de Mexico gov.
newsitem.headline: Sidaoui ratified as deputy Banco de Mexico gov.

text.p: Mexico's Senate has approved outgoing Deputy Finance Minister Jose Sidaoui as Banco de Mexico deputy governor, officials said on Wednesday.
Sidaoui, who will become a deputy governor on January 1, 1997, replaces outoging deputy governor Ariel Buira.
In a Senate ratification hearing on Tuuesday he said Banco de Mexico was committed to cutting inflation and would maintain a floating peso.
"Mexico's monetary policy has the clear objective to reduce inflation in a permanent and definite form," Sidaoui was quoted by El Economista as saying.
He also said the central bank had no intention of shifting from a floating peso regime, the newspaper reported.
